Text: Getting an AI agent demo working is easier than covering the pieces that make it deployable, observable, and safer to operate.

Agents Towards Production is a hands-on tutorial collection for builders moving GenAI agents beyond isolated prototypes.

It helps you work through the agent stack with runnable notebooks and code organized around specific components and integration patterns.

Key features:
• Stateful orchestration – build graph-based, multi-step workflows with LangGraph.
• Memory and RAG – explore Redis, Mem0, Cognee, and Contextual AI tutorials.
• Deployment paths – work through Docker, FastAPI, Ollama, AWS AgentCore, and GPU examples.
• Security and evaluation – study guardrails, prompt-injection testing, tracing, and automated evaluation.
• Tool and agent integration – cover MCP, A2A, web access, and secure OAuth2 tool calling.
